author: Zero C# contributors
name: Zero C# microcontroller program (Raspberry Pi Pico 2)
description: A program for a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 (or an Arduino Uno R4, in QEMU): a C# interrupt handler blinks the LED. No .NET runtime, no garbage collector, no operating system.

board.description: The board the program is for.

choices.description: Raspberry Pi Pico 2 (RP2350, Cortex-M33): a .uf2 for the board, and an .elf for QEMU
Arduino Uno R4 (RA4M1, Cortex-M4, 32 KB of RAM): an .elf for QEMU
